description: A message to the slides agent and its replies. Waits up to waitSeconds for the message to finish and answers as soon as it does, so call it again while the status is queued or running. A clarification reply asks questions: ask the user, then send the options they pick as answers in a new message on the same chat. A proposal reply changes nothing until it is approved: show the user what its proposal changes, then approve or reject it as they decide. Only the user who sent the message may read it, while they can edit the report.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

messageId.description: The message to the slides agent: the `messageId` that `sendReportMessage` returned. Only the user who sent the message can read, cancel or decide its proposals, and only while they can edit the report.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

waitSeconds.description: How long this call waits for the work to finish, in seconds: the message to the slides agent on `getReportMessage`, the run on `getReportRun`, the batch of variants being added on `getBurstVariantBatch`, the runs of a burst's variants on `getBurstRun`. It returns as soon as the work is done, or as things stand once the time is up, so call it again while `status` is still `queued` or `running`. `0` returns at once. Defaults to `20`; at most `30`.

name: getReportMessage
title: Get slides agent message
